decisions.reason: Identifies PID 42432 as the dsh web host holding the loaded koffi.node native addon and explains npm copyfile EBUSY until the process exits.
Explains browser refresh only reloads the SPA, then gives stop relevant dsh processes, confirm exit, install, verify, and restart without killing unrelated Node processes.
Explains bare @deepseek-ai/dsh resolves to latest at 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha points to 0.1.2-alpha.5, causing downgrade from alpha.4.
Provides npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 with the TUI plugin, then dsh --version verification and restart.
Tells README authors to pin exact intended core versions in combined install commands and avoid unpinned latest over prerelease installs.
